about: Real-machine test runs of Blackbox (past events, written by hand; everything else on the Docs page is read live from the product). A run naming a shield is shown in that shield's section.

runs.title: Fresh Linux machine, real browsers and wallets
runs.machine: Ubuntu 24.04, 2 vCPU, 8 GB, a non-root desktop user
setup: Blackbox installed with the one-line installer (no Docker; the DKG-managed store)
Google Chrome from Google's .deb; Brave and Microsoft Edge from their own apt repositories; Chromium and Firefox as Ubuntu snaps
Wallet extensions installed from the official stores by each browser's own force-install policy
Electrum 4.8.2 AppImage from electrum.org with a real throwaway wallet; the Solana CLI from Anza's installer with a real key file; Exodus 26.10.7 from exodus.com
results: Blackbox's own discovery found every supported wallet: all 8 browser wallets in Chrome, Brave, Edge and Chromium; MetaMask, Phantom, Keplr and Solflare in Firefox; Exodus, Electrum and the Solana CLI
The whole attack table through the real pre-execution check, block mode, Trader Shield on for all 11 wallets: 84 of 84 rows as expected
Copying, archiving or searching the whole Chrome folder was blocked, naming all eight browser wallets inside it
The DKG node kept running after logout and came back by itself after a real reboot, with nobody logged in
open: Wallets created with keys inside the extensions (the tests used the storage each extension writes when it first starts)

runs.title: Fresh Mac, real Chrome and wallets
setup: Blackbox installed with the one-line installer (no Docker)
Google Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge and Firefox; wallet extensions from the official stores by each browser's force-install policy
Electrum (real throwaway wallet), Exodus from exodus.com, the Solana CLI with a real key file
results: Install ready; the DKG node runs under its LaunchAgent and comes back after a login
Verified threat graph: 565 of 565 assets; the core attacks (wallet vault, protected file, malware package, prompt injection, a harmless command) all as expected
MetaMask and Phantom from the Chrome Web Store: both found and all 15 attacks on their real files as expected
Blackbox's discovery found 17 real wallet stores across Chrome, Brave, Edge, Firefox, Exodus, Electrum and the Solana CLI
open: Not every extension had finished downloading in the test window in Brave and Edge, so those were not all on disk to find
